import pygame
import sys
import time
import random

width, height = 800, 600

clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    fps_text = font.render(f"FPS: {int(fps)}", True, (0, 0, 0))

    # Fill the display

    # Draw the FPS counter
    display.blit(fps_text, (10, 10))

    # Update the display
    pygame.display.flip()

    # Cap the frame rate
    clock.tick(60)

# Quit the game
pygame.quit()
sys.exit()
